mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real GDP growth exceeds 3% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals a potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Industrial production declines > 2% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate rises > 1% in 3 months, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts signals increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase > 10% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Nonfarm payrolls increase > 200k per month for 3 consecutive months, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index signals increased inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI rises > 3% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in real retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Real retail sales decline > 2% YoY, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive more than 60% of the time.
